prompt: Make an accurate fine contour museum plate of the Song Iron Pagoda at Kaifeng, using photo2 for entire tower profile and photo3 for lower facade details. Image1 Longmen Buddha is STYLE ONLY. The lowest storey is taller and broader; then twelve upper eaves with the small pointed top roof and bead finial. Count all13 including top roof, not14. Preserve actual proportions, arched/small openings alternating on faces, intricate glazed imitations of wooden brackets simplified to clean outlines, and the small lower entrance in photo3. Tower only, fullheight with3facetsvisible, nearfront eye-level elevation. Remove all street scenery, lanterns, flowers, people, trees and signs. Do not darken ceramic surfaces: this is NOT a dark silhouette or photo filter, it is sparse precise black lines on pure white. Most wall surfaces blank, a few framed tile motifs only, NO dense grid of every tile and NO hatching. Fine thin line quality and breathing space like first image. 了不起的古建筑丨开封铁塔：我国现存最早最高琉璃砖塔
historical_sources.note: 北宋皇祐元年（1049）始建、八角十三层仿楼阁式琉璃塔；琉璃砖首次用于造塔、褐色远看似铁、元代起称铁塔；平座排水；1961年首批国保；地面以上高55.08米（与多数记载55.88米不同）。页面直接访问403，内容据搜索摘要

historical_sources.title: 中国现存最早最高的琉璃砖塔：开宝寺塔
historical_sources.note: 十三层楼阁式、红褐蓝绿琉璃砖、飞天麒麟游龙雄狮坐佛立僧伎乐花草等五十多种图案。页面直接访问403，内容据搜索摘要

historical_sources.title: 开宝寺琉璃塔
historical_sources.note: 维基百科，二手来源（引张驭寰《中国名塔》1984等）；喻浩建灵感木塔、庆历四年（1044）雷火焚毁、皇祐元年（1049）建成；高55.88米、底层每面阔4.16米；明代改称祐国寺塔；地震38次、黄河水患9次；日军炮击；1956年修葺开放

historical_sources.title: Iron Pagoda
historical_sources.note: 维基百科，二手来源（引 Gao Daiheng 2002、Needham 1971）；1847年黄河决口祐国寺毁塔存；檐下104风铃；琉璃砖五十余种

site_recommendation.name: 开封铁塔
site_recommendation.lede: 十三层密集的檐线缓缓收向塔顶。开封铁塔并非铁铸，深褐色琉璃砖让这座宋塔获得了沿用至今的名字。
facts: 祐国寺塔建于北宋皇祐元年（1049），为八角十三层琉璃砖塔。
塔面以模制琉璃砖拼砌斗栱、门窗和装饰，密集檐口形成稳定的节奏。
图版以完整塔身照片为主、底层近照为补充，保留十三层，不复原前身木塔。
